text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало and I go into town.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait a minute. That poster over
there...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ooh... It looks like they're holding an art

exhibition.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, why don't we go take a
look? It
seems to be nearby.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Here we are! Ahh, now this is a place fit
for a king
like me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
First-rate people go to first-rate places,
after all.
Attending events such as
orchestral concerts and
the like.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
As my trainer, you should keep a list of
such
first-rate destinations in mind.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! But of course!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Paintings created by first-rate artists are
filled
with emotion!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Here, look at the painting showcased on
the
poster.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Even though the painting looks messy at
first
glance, it conveys the artist's state
of mind!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It must have been done by a first-rate
painter. I
wonder who the artist is... Let's
see...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало and I both look closely at the

exhibition poster.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: "I Wuv You Mommy and Daddy, from the Kindergarten Collection."
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: There's definitely a lot of emotion in there.
It's not quite a first-rate painter, is it?

text_block_list.text: "I Wuv You Mommy and Daddy, from the Kindergarten Collection."
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: There's definitely a lot of emotion in there.
It's not quite a first-rate painter, is it?

text_block_list.text: Oh... Ohohoho! But of course!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
This work is simply brimming with the
youthful
artist's feelings for their
parents!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
To the parents, their child is a first-rate
painter!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's go see it right away! Admission is
free, which
is truly first-rate!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The artists gave their all to create these
works!
They're so adorable! So soothing
and refreshing!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this kind of exhibition isn't half
bad.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
W-well, when it comes to first-rate
painters,
being famous or not is of no
concern!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Being first-rate is all about whether you
touch
people's hearts!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
This painting has left a deep impression
on me!
That's why it's definitely
first-rate!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I seems I'll need to make it clearer for
you... Come
on, let's go inside and take
a look!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Look at the faces of the artists' parents
as they
look at the paintings! Happiness
itself!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
There's the proof of how well it touches
people's
hearts! Take care to remember
what the essence
of first-rate looks like!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I feel warm and fuzzy as I wander
through the
museum with Кинг Хало.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that's how visiting a museum with
Кинг Хало
taught me the true meaning of
first-rate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
